title: Smart data models - Sensor schema
description: Device, agent (including humans), or software (simulation) involved in, or implementing, a Procedure. Sensors respond to a stimulus, e.g., a change in the environment, or input data composed from the results of prior Observations, and generate a Result. Sensors can be hosted by Platforms.

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be equal to `Sensor`

observes.description: Property. Model: ''. Relation between a Sensor and an ObservableProperty that it is capable of sensing.

madeObservation.description: Property. Model: ''. Relation between a Sensor and an Observation made by the Sensor.

isHostedBy.description: Property. Model: ''. Relation between a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, and the Platform that it is mounted on or hosted by.
